# prime-popover

prime-rs: Popover component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/popover) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-popover) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/popover.md)

Popover — port of `p-popover` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

A floating panel with arbitrary content next to a trigger element. The panel is controlled by `PopoverRef`
(the counterpart of `op.toggle($event)` in PrimeNG): create it in advance, pass it to `Popover` and call it from handlers.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_popover::{Popover, PopoverRef};

let html = view! {
    <Popover popover_ref=PopoverRef::new()>
        <p>"Body"</p>
    </Popover>
}
.to_html();
// while the panel is not shown, it is not in the markup
assert!(!html.contains("p-popover") && !html.contains("Body"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-popover = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["popover"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
